name: zsnd_sample_play_on_directsound
description: zSndSample::PlayOnDirectSound starts a DirectSound voice, restores lost buffers, updates optional 3D state, sets start position, and plays.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage includes no-position simple playback and non-null world-position playback through zSndSample::PlayA3D.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49fbb0 validates create-guard and flag-0x10 gates, backend play-handle acquisition, DirectSound GetStatus/Restore path, optional world-position Update3DDispatch path, muted/non-muted volume path, start-position set, and Play call.
The native smokes verify no-position DirectSound volume/current-position/play behavior and world-position DirectSound pan, attenuation, velocity capture, current-position, and play behavior.
